entries.zh: 开始做某事、着手（西语词头义）；所录「時」与对音 fīn/cheñ 不合，义待考
entries.en: to begin to do something; to start (headword sense; the recorded 時 does not fit the readings)
entries.notes: 四栏互证失败：時读 sî/shí，与 M「Fīn」R「cheñ」不合；仅能依「Empeçar de hazer algo」定夺，汉字侧义无着。

entries.zh: 开始、着手（同上条，叠用）；所录「時躊」疑即「躊躇」（犹豫不决），两说未能定夺
entries.en: to begin, to set about (same headword, reduplicated); perh. 躊躇 "to hesitate"
entries.notes: 第二字标疑（躊/躇），M 作 fīn fīn、R 作 cheñ chỳ，均不能证成「开始」义；释义存疑。

entries.en: to poison; to harm, to injure

entries.zh: （振作精神）紧握、握持（武器）；持鎗
entries.en: to grip, to clutch (a weapon) with spirit; to wield a spear
entries.notes: 汉字「頭鎗」与 empuñir（握持）的衔接系推断，M、R 两栏皆带 T99 污损。

entries.zh: （刀剑的）柄、握把；亦作量词「柄」（计刀剑）
entries.en: hilt, handle (of a sword); also a numeral classifier for bladed weapons
entries.notes: L 栏「delagapada」当为「de la espada」之讹残；M 栏多出 gion 一音节，量词义依「y numeral」推定。

entries.en: in, at, on (preposition of place or time)

entries.zh: 一眨眼（之间）；转瞬，极短的时间
entries.en: in the blink of an eye; in an instant
entries.notes: 首字标疑（睦/睜），M 栏四音节且带 T99；义据西语成语与次条「目瞑」互证。

entries.zh: 眨眼之间；转瞬（「目瞑」谓闭眼，喻时极短）
entries.en: in the blink of an eye (lit. the eyes shutting); in an instant
entries.notes: M、R 两栏均带 T99 污损，R 四音节对音不整齐，释义依汉字与西语成语定。

entries.en: on going out of the door; as soon as one steps outside
at this time; in the meantime
entries.notes: 末字「完」于「en este tiempo」无着，疑原件作「間」而音写为 oan/van；依前三栏定夺。

entries.en: the world; this world (as opposed to the next)
entries.notes: R 栏「sy guin」与「界」对音不合，疑与次条「世間」之对音相混；M 栏另多 say 一音节。
